title: Problem
问题
html:
Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11006. Public status: arXiv preprint, 2026. Most code benchmarks score whether generated code passes tests, but that says little about which execution-relevant program structure a model can recover from existing source.

The evaluation object is source program, prompt/task metadata, predicted call-graph edges, execution-witnessed reference edges, precision, recall, and F1. The feedback contract is execution tracers mechanically witness positive runtime call edges; normalized edge sets are scored with precision/recall/F1. This belongs in the collection as an auditable benchmark or environment surface; it is not by itself proof of deployable reliability, and training use should be inferred only where the paper explicitly releases data for that purpose.

一手来源：https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11006。公开状态是 arXiv preprint，年份为 2026。多数代码评测关注生成代码是否通过测试，但这并不能说明模型能从已有源码中恢复哪些与执行相关的程序结构。

评测对象包括源码、任务元数据、模型预测的调用图边、执行见证的参考边、精确率、召回率和 F1。反馈契约是语言专用追踪器见证正例运行时调用边，再把标准化后的预测边与参考边比较。它应作为代码语义诊断评测来读；它不是完整软件工程能力分数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
One-sentence contribution: TraceEval evaluates code semantic reasoning by asking models to recover runtime call structure whose positive edges are witnessed by validation execution. The contribution is an execution-verified, multi-language call-graph recovery benchmark, plus a pipeline for turning repositories into new verified instances.

The data object contains program source, language, split, tracer-witnessed edges, model-predicted edges, precision, recall, F1. Success is decided by predicted normalized runtime edges match the execution-witnessed reference edge set. Closest comparisons are static web benchmarks, tool-use datasets, or code benchmarks in the same domain, but the direction label here is the concrete evaluation surface and its verifier rather than a general capability claim.

一句话贡献：TraceEval 通过运行验证过的调用边，评测模型能否从源码恢复程序运行时调用结构。主要贡献是一个运行验证、多语言的调用图恢复评测，以及把开源仓库转成新验证样本的流水线。

数据对象包含程序源码、语言、划分、追踪器见证的调用边、模型预测的调用边、精确率、召回率和 F1。成功条件是模型预测的标准化运行时调用边与执行见证的参考边匹配。最接近的对比对象是静态调用图工具、人工标注调用图和普通代码生成测试，但这里的方向标签应落在运行见证的代码语义评测。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are open-source repositories converted into runtime call-graph recovery instances through LLM-assisted harness generation and tracer validation. Outputs are source program, prompt/task metadata, predicted call-graph edges, execution-witnessed reference edges, precision, recall, and F1. The substrate is Python, JavaScript, and Java execution harnesses with language-specific tracing.

Pipeline: 1. construct or load the task instance; 2. run the model or system under the official harness; 3. collect actions, observations, answers, or predicted structures; 4. apply execution tracers mechanically witness positive runtime call edges; normalized edge sets are scored with precision/recall/F1; 5. aggregate scores only under a pinned version of the benchmark. Reproducibility requires pinning paper=https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11006, project=https://github.com/yikun-li/TraceEva, code=https://github.com/yikun-li/TraceEva, data=https://github.com/yikun-li/TraceEva, plus the exact split, runtime, scorer, prompt/scaffold, and release revision.

输入来自开源仓库中抽取的 Python、JavaScript 和 Java 程序，以及由流水线生成的运行框架。输出包括源码、语言、划分、追踪器见证的调用边、模型预测边、精确率、召回率和 F1。底层环境是带语言专用追踪器的执行框架。

流程可以压缩成五步：1. 从仓库构造程序实例；2. 生成并运行测试框架；3. 由追踪器见证运行时调用边；4. 将模型预测边与见证边标准化后计算精确率、召回率和 F1；5. 只在固定划分和追踪器版本下聚合分数。复现时必须固定 arXiv 论文、TraceEva 仓库、数据划分、依赖环境、追踪器、标准化规则和评分脚本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The arXiv abstract reports 10,583 programs from 1,600+ repositories, a held-out zero-shot evaluation over 10 LLMs, Claude-Opus-4.6 at 72.9 average F1, and Qwen2.5-Coder fine-tuning gains up to +55.6 F1.

Instance-level evidence comes from the released task object and the scorer: execution tracers mechanically witness positive runtime call edges; normalized edge sets are scored with precision/recall/F1. Aggregate scores are meaningful only for the reported split, model setup, and harness. Public artifacts support inspection, but they do not remove contamination, dependency, or license checks.

arXiv 摘要报告 10,583 个程序、1,600 多个仓库、10 个模型的零样本测试，Claude-Opus-4.6 平均 F1 为 72.9，并展示 Qwen2.5-Coder 微调最高 +55.6 F1。

样本级证据来自执行追踪器见证的运行时调用边，以及精确率、召回率和 F1 评分脚本。聚合分数只对论文报告的划分、模型设置和运行框架成立。公开工件便于复查，但不能自动消除上游仓库许可、依赖版本和路径覆盖风险。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new feedback contract is that positive call edges are witnessed by execution, rather than produced by static tools or hand labels alone.

The prior-work baseline is narrower task lists, static benchmarks, or less stateful evaluation surfaces. What changes is the combination of task object, environment or data substrate, and feedback contract. What is not new is benchmarking or model scoring in general. Before reuse, inspect split policy, release license, artifact revision, scorer implementation, prompt/scaffold, and whether public examples have entered training data.

新的反馈契约是：正例调用边由实际执行见证，而不是只来自静态工具输出或人工标注。

已有基线通常是更窄的任务列表、静态 benchmark 或状态更弱的评测面。这里变化的是任务对象、环境或数据基底，以及反馈契约的组合。并不新的部分是做模型评测本身。复用前要检查划分策略、发布许可、工件版本、评分器实现、提示或脚手架，以及公开样本是否已经进入训练数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Execution validates observed behavior, not every possible path; labels depend on harness generation, tracer coverage, dependency versions, and upstream repository licenses.

Correctness is only relative to the released verifier or environment. A passing score may hide semantic failures outside the checked state, unobserved paths, tool/API drift, judge bias, public-task contamination, or scaffold-specific shortcuts. Do not read the benchmark as a universal verifier or as a reward signal without a separate audit.

运行验证只覆盖被观察到的行为，不覆盖所有可能路径；标签依赖测试框架生成、追踪器覆盖、依赖版本和上游仓库许可。

正确性只相对于已释放的验证器或环境成立。通过分数可能掩盖检查状态之外的语义错误、未覆盖路径、工具或 API 漂移、评审偏差、公开任务污染，或脚手架带来的捷径。不要把 benchmark 读成通用验证器，也不要未经单独审计就当成奖励信号。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Retain language, repository provenance, split, harness, tracer version, normalized edge format, upstream license metadata, and scoring script.

The card is useful as an evaluation-surface schema: it tells the reader what input, trajectory, output, scorer, and provenance fields must survive if the work is reused for benchmarking, filtering, analysis, or supervised training. Its value for the collection is the explicit feedback contract, not only the headline score.

复用时要保留语言、仓库来源、划分、测试框架、追踪器版本、标准化边格式、上游许可元数据和评分脚本。

这张卡适合当作评测面 schema 使用：它说明如果下游要复用该工作进行评测、过滤、分析或监督训练，哪些输入、轨迹、输出、评分器和来源字段必须保留下来。它对库的价值在明确反馈契约，而不只是标题里的分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Separate execution-witnessed runtime semantics from general code generation quality; TraceEval is a diagnostic benchmark, not a full software-engineering score.

Read the official paper first, then inspect the repository or dataset release. Keep data construction, model training, evaluation harness, judge/verifier, and leaderboard numbers separate. If a license, split, snapshot, or judge version is not pinned, treat comparisons as provisional.

要把运行见证的运行时语义与通用代码生成质量分开；TraceEval 是诊断性评测，不是完整软件工程能力分数。

阅读顺序是先看官方论文，再看代码仓库或数据发布。要把数据构造、模型训练、评测框架、评审器或验证器、排行榜数字分开。如果许可、划分、快照或评审器版本没有固定，比较结论就只能视为暂定。
